notes.title: v1.01 - Audio bug hotfix!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

Just a quick update fixing an audio bug! 

Changelog:

Fixed the secret track playing when you start dragging the ground, instead of the drag-sound. Only happened on Windows. Would cause the song to play many times over each other, which was quite annoying!


Somehow those sound files were swapped - whoops! Really sorry for this bug, hopefully it didn't ruin your first experience with the game!

Thanks to everyone who played and enjoyed the game - love hearing back what players think and how they feel about it!

Have fun!

- Ruben
